summary: Initial Time Loop art package: 12 reusable raster placeholder assets covering the player, ghost replay silhouette, level tileset, switch, pressure plate, door, laser emitter/beam, enemy, exit crystal, HUD panel with timeline track, UI buttons plus ghost timeline markers and clock hand, and a title backdrop with overlapping clock hands and ghost silhouettes. Both mounted libraries reported available=false in this environment, so no library paths or licenses are claimed; every asset is an image-service placeholder (mock-image.v1) generated to final target dimensions so Developer can integrate now. Libraries remain permitted for later replacement, and all generated visuals are placeholders pending final visual acceptance. No engine run, screenshot inspection, or gameplay/visual quality verification is claimed. Image generation was mocked; final artwork remains pending.

assets.purpose: Base player character sprite sheet for running, idle and jumping, reused as the temporal anchor of every loop.
assets.license: Synthetic test placeholder; replace before assessing art quality. No third-party artwork used.
assets.integration_notes: Copy to assets/sprites/player_sheet.png. Filter: nearest. Grid: 4 x 1. Frames (row-major): player_idle, player_run_a, player_run_b, player_jump. Import as SpriteFrames with a 4x1 grid, nearest filtering, no mipmaps. AnimatedSprite2D on the player scene; draw at integer scale 2x (64x64 on screen) inside the 1280x720 viewport. Ground baseline sits at the bottom row of each cell, so place the sprite origin at the feet. Frame timing: idle loop 8 fps, run 12 fps, jump held static. Do not bake a shadow; add a separate simple ellipse if needed. assets.purpose: Translucent ghost silhouette sheet so past-loop replays are visually distinct from the current player.
assets.license: Synthetic test placeholder; replace before assessing art quality. No third-party artwork used.
assets.integration_notes: Copy to assets/sprites/ghost_sheet.png. Filter: nearest. Grid: 4 x 1. Frames (row-major): ghost_idle, ghost_run_a, ghost_run_b, ghost_jump. Import identical to the player sheet (4x1 grid, nearest). Spawn one instance per recorded loop, cap four. Drive opacity with CanvasItem.modulate.a between 0.45 and 0.65 and vary hue slightly per loop index so layered ghosts stay distinguishable; also tint the marker cell from ui_controls to match. Ghosts must not collide with the current player. Developer may alternatively reuse player_sheet with runtime tint/opacity, but this dedicated silhouette is the preferred primary art.
